label: Token Efficiency
description: Rules for keeping token usage low and being cost-effective.

aspects.name: rules
attributes: Read a skill ONCE, cache the key facts in your graph, never re-fetch
Don't re-read files you just wrote
Keep responses concise — long explanations burn output tokens for you and input tokens next turn
Use delegate_task for heavy work — runs in separate context
Cache operational knowledge in your graph — don't rely on re-fetching the same info every session
